author: The Current
description:
tofusmell, the project of musician Rae Chen, spoke with The Current’s Morning Show about moving from Winter Garden, Florida to Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada.

Read and listen to the full interview now at thecurrent.org

tofusmell will be performing tonight Thursday, August 6 for The Current Happy Hour Series at Plains Art Museum in Fargo, ND.

Find more information at thecurrent.org/happyhours
